title: Market-neutral and bear-phase crypto sleeves for crypto prop firms
registered: 2026-10-15, before any Gen62 result was computed
data: Binance USD-M pack, 20 coins, daily from 5-min klines, funding included in every P&L, taker 5 bp/side unless stated
split: DEV 2020-2022 (includes the 2022 bear market) | TEST 2023-2024 | HOLD 2025-2026
pass: primary rule: TEST Sharpe >= 0.8, HOLD >= 0.5, DEV > 0, correlation with C* <= 0.3. A variant only replaces the primary if it also passes AND both of its neighbouring grid points have 2023+ Sharpe > 0.5 (stability). Bear-sleeve extra condition: 2022 return > 0.

H1 pairs (cointegration).rule: first day of each month: on the previous F days of daily log prices, test all 190 pairs (Engle-Granger p < 0.05, correlation > 0.8, half-life 2-30 days); keep the 5 with the shortest half-life. Next month: spread = log A - beta log B (formation OLS beta), z from the formation mean/std; enter |z| > Z, exit |z| < 0.5, stop |z| > 4 or at month end. 0.2 notional per leg per pair.

H2 premium/basis variants (baseline = Ge.H2a: residual premium: 7-day average premium minus its own 60-day average (removes each coin's persistent premium); long lowest third, short highest; weekly
H2 premium/basis variants (baseline = Ge.H2b: combined rank: average of G4 premium rank and 7-day funding rank; weekly
H2 premium/basis variants (baseline = Ge.H2c: G4 with inverse-volatility weights inside each leg (30-day vol), legs still dollar-neutral
H2 premium/basis variants (baseline = Ge.accept: a variant replaces G4 only if it passes AND beats G4 by >= 0.10 in BOTH TEST and HOLD

H3 bear-phase short sleeve.rule: only when BTC close < its 200-day MA: short every coin whose close < its M-day MA and whose L-day return < 0; inverse-vol weights, sleeve vol target 10%; flat otherwise

H4 cascade with regime filter.rule: Gen57 B4 cascade buy (1h return < -3 sigma, OI -5%, volume > 95th pct; stop low - 1 ATR), only when BTC close > its 200-day MA (as of the previous daily close); at most K open events; hold H hours; 0.2 notional each

ideas.H7 portfolio weights (descriptive): equal risk (fixed) vs inverse-volatility re-weighted monthly on trailing 90 days; reported, not used for selection
